description: Inventory of workflow rules by audience (roadmap D-18). Every rule with scope delegate or both must be present in .agents/delegation/delegate-contract.md; scripts/validate-delegate-contract.mjs enforces it. Add a row here when a new rule must reach delegates.

rules.rule: Delegates never restart intake, readiness, discovery, slicing, matching, or routing.
rules.contractPattern: must not restart those parent stages or recursively\s+reroute

rules.rule: A new delegate reads its complete skill, applicable instructions, and controlling source.
rules.contractPattern: reads its complete required skill, applicable instructions

rules.rule: Pre-injected content is reused only with observable provenance and freshness.
rules.contractPattern: provenance, and its current freshness observable

rules.rule: A resumed delegate revalidates the relevant delta and dependencies.
rules.contractPattern: revalidates the relevant delta and affected dependencies

rules.rule: Input is the role-relevant subset; nobody re-pastes the full PRD or tracker.
unknown is a record of unavailable evidence, not permission.
rules.contractPattern: `unknown` is a record of unavailable evidence, not permission

rules.rule: No raw dumps, full logs, or broad searches as a first step.
rules.contractPattern: No raw dumps, no full logs, no broad

rules.rule: Capabilities are never installed or attached without confirmation.
rules.contractPattern: Never install or attach a capability without

rules.rule: Never claim a model switch the runtime did not confirm.
rules.contractPattern: Never claim a model switch the runtime did not confirm

rules.rule: No compressed output for security warnings, irreversible actions, or risks.
rules.contractPattern: Do not use compressed output for security

rules.rule: The neutral contract wins over a runtime adapter.
Edit only owned files; one writer per file.
rules.contractPattern: Edit only explicitly owned files; one writer per file

rules.rule: At most 2 repair rounds per slice; one recovery attempt for environment failures; one rerun for flaky tests.
rules.contractPattern: At most 2 repair rounds per slice

rules.rule: Handoffs return only new information.
Anything not covered stops and returns blocked to the orchestrator.
rules.contractPattern: stop and return `blocked` to the orchestrator

rules.rule: Every prompt is classified N0-N3 before loading workflow files.
Intent language is not execution authorization for N2/N3.
A routing trace is emitted before loading the selected skill.
The AI never decides alone to create a PRD, epic, or ticket.
Continuation turns do not reload policy files.
Only the orchestrator edits .agents/project-context.md, and only at closure.
